sources.claim: Claude Code is an AI helper that writes code, and it usually lives in a plain text window.
sources.source: Claude Code is a command-line tool from Anthropic. You give it a goal in plain English, and it plans the steps, uses tools, and works through them until the goal is done. You'll usually meet it inside a terminal — a plain text window where you type a request and read the reply.

sources.claim: Session Manager is a free desktop app that gives Claude Code a friendly home.
sources.source: Session Manager is a free desktop app. It gives Claude Code a friendly home to live in, and it lets you run a small team of these agents at once, instead of just one.

sources.claim: You say what you want. One helper plans it. Others build it. One more checks it.
sources.source: You describe what you want. One agent plans it. Other agents build the pieces. One more checks the result.

sources.claim: It keeps working while you are away.
sources.source: a work calendar called the Scheduler lines it all up and runs it, even while you're away from your keyboard.

sources.claim: If you run low on usage, it waits, then picks back up.
sources.source: When you're close to that limit, the Scheduler pauses on its own rather than firing work orders that would fail — and picks back up by itself once your usage window resets. (README: Auto-pauses if a job hits a rate limit, auto-resumes at the next reset.)

sources.claim: Queue diagram: work waits, runs, then is done; a pause never stops work that is already running.
sources.source: Pending: Waiting its turn. Running: A dev-lead is working on it right now. Completed: Done. Pause stops new work orders from starting. Anything already running keeps running — Pause never kills work mid-flight.

sources.claim: Each project gets its own tab.
sources.source: Session Manager works on one project folder at a time, and it keeps a separate tab for each one you open.

sources.claim: One page shows all your work.
sources.source: Home is the Dashboard — a one-page overview of every project and every Session on your machine.

sources.claim: Just talk: your voice turns into text on your own computer.
sources.source: Voice lets you talk to your agents with your microphone instead of typing. Your speech is transcribed on your own machine and turned into text. (README Voice: Nothing leaves the machine.)

sources.claim: A red bar shows whenever the mic is on.
sources.source: Whenever your microphone is capturing audio, a red bar appears at the very top of the window and says so in plain words.

sources.claim: Check on your work from your phone or any browser; only you can read it.
sources.source: You can work with Session Manager from a phone or any browser ... Everything travels through the bilko.run relay, scrambled so that only your browser and your computer can read it.

sources.claim: You get a small team, and you stay in charge.
sources.source: instead of one assistant, you get a small team (welcome). The agency does the typing; you stay the director. (meet-your-agency)
Open-core: the APP and the Field Manual are both free, and stay free. (bilko.listing.json: pricing free; Ships with a free Field Manual.)

sources.claim: Try Session Manager free at bilko.run/products/session-manager.
sources.source: Session Manager itself is free. Download the installer for your computer from https://bilko.run/products/session-manager .
